settings.title: Like Human
settings.author: Visual Novel Editor examples
settings.description: A short story about an android and the engineer who built her. Shows every major feature: branching, conditions, cross-chapter jumps, animation, effects, scripts and modules.

dialogue.text: …Signal detected. Visual input online.
Oh! You’re awake. Can you hear me?
I’m Mika. I built you — well, most of you.
Try something for me. Say anything. Or… do anything.
You did it! Your voice module works.
Empathy calibration: {empathy}.
Come on. There’s something I want to show you.
[ERROR] Response buffer empty.
Nothing? …That’s okay. Silence is an answer too.
Let’s run the calibration anyway.
Calibration failed. Entering sleep mode.
Goodnight, Seven. We’ll try again.

data.label: Sleep Mode
data.message: Seven went back to sleep. Try being a little more… human.

data.text:
Click Mika in “Boot sequence” to reveal a hidden choice (see its Scripts tab).
The dice check uses the Dice Check module.

dialogue.text: This is the city I grew up in.
It is very loud. And very bright. And wet.
Ha! That’s the rain. Do you like it?

choices.text: I like it, because you are here.

dialogue.text: …Oh.
Where did you learn to say things like that?
That’s fine. Nobody really does.
You learn it by noticing what you miss when it’s gone.
When I was little, my father repaired old TVs in this room.
He said every machine has a little bit of its maker inside.
Then he got sick. And the room got very quiet.
She is reaching for your hand.
We stayed until the sun came up.
Mika. I think this is what you call “happy”.
Yeah. I think it is.
Mika went home early.
Rain: 100%. Understanding: 12%. Logging for tomorrow.

data.label: Just a Machine
data.message: Some things take more than one try.

data.text:
Memory has a Timed Choices module (Modules tab) and uses the shared “Old film” effect.
The pink node is an Affection Branch from the Relationships module.
